original_hook: 📰 According to Cointelegraph, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s comments pushed USD/JPY down toward 153, triggering fresh yen carry-trade unwind fears as $BTC failed to hold $80K. Source: Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub When the yen strengthens sharply, multi-asset funds are forced to deleverage gross risk across liquid positions to service yen-denominated liabilities. This structural FX squeeze overpowers the geopolitical safe-haven narrative, causing spot BTC to fall alongside equities. The setup invalidates simple headline trading: $BTC won't cleanly track gold until USD/JPY volatility settles and cross-asset deleveraging slows. Bullish, bearish, or wait?
